title: tessera.audit-traffic/1
description: A traffic profile for `tessera audit plan` (RFC-0016 'Calculators'): one entry per bucket of the policy, in its order. `tessera audit plan` reads it strictly: no key may be missing or unknown, and the profile must have as many buckets as the policy.

buckets.description: One entry per bucket of the policy, in its order.

requests.description: `n_b`: the requests whose length falls in the bucket over a period, a 64-bit unsigned integer.

tokens.description: `L_b`: their mean length in tokens, above the previous bucket's `max_tokens` and at most the bucket's own. The cost model's `μ_b` is taken at it.

violations.description: `v_b`: the violating requests among them, at most `requests`.
